summary: All 5 FEATs are complete and verified. The API key no longer leaks into production builds, strict TypeScript is enabled, the coordinator lifecycle bug is fixed, settings persistence is wired, test coverage is added for parseAiJson/IndexedDB/provider HTTP shape, dead scaffolding is removed, and the WordNet pointer stride is corrected. One minor defect: a duplicate `pruneHistory` call in Overlay.tsx (harmless, redundant work only).

findings.description: Duplicate `await pruneHistory(historyLimitRef.current)` call — the statement appears twice consecutively inside `persistHistory` after `addHistory`. The second call is a no-op (list is already trimmed) but triggers an unnecessary IndexedDB round-trip on every lookup.
findings.suggestion: Remove the second occurrence of `if (historyLimitRef.current > 0) await pruneHistory(historyLimitRef.current)` on line 74.
